findings.issue: Real-time setTimeout(700) used to wait past the 600ms FunnelMessagePreview debounce before asserting backend call and preview rendering. Works correctly but is slow (~700ms per run) and carries a low risk of flakiness on heavily loaded CI runners where the 700ms window may not be sufficient.
findings.recommendation: Replace the real wait with fake timers: call `vi.useFakeTimers()` before the emit, then `vi.advanceTimersByTime(700)` in place of the setTimeout, and restore with `vi.useRealTimers()` in afterEach. This makes the test deterministic, fast, and immune to runner load.

summary: All 5 new tests are value-based and load-bearing. FunnelCanvas tests assert rendered text content and chip counts by value (not existence-only), XSS test verifies entity-encoding in DOM HTML. Page-level tests assert heading text, FunnelMessagePreview props by value (stepType, id, stepNumber), storeMock.preview call with the correct step id, and rendered preview-keyboard element — the full wiring from canvas node selection through to preview panel is covered. required-keys.spec.ts adds clearKeyboard to both presence and non-empty value checks for both locales. No existing preview/MESSAGE coverage was weakened. One minor finding: real setTimeout(700) for debounce handling should use fake timers instead.
